I saved the 20 November deadline for Tamsin Cold Chain's signed order form in the knowledge brain, and noted that it came from Ilse in #north-team on 14 October. I replied in her thread to say so.

I couldn't check the date against anything. I found no Tamsin order form or contract in the shared files, and searching the brain turned up nothing else about this deadline. So it's on record as Ilse's word, not as something a document confirms.
